method: 50 prioritized prospects selected from 60 researched company records. Geography comes first: 28 Chennai/nearby industrial-belt factories, 14 elsewhere in Tamil Nadu and 8 elsewhere in South India. Within each area, judgment weighs production similarity, concrete factory evidence and access to leadership. Rubber is the main cohort; nearby moulding, heat-treatment, metalworking and packaging firms broaden discovery. This is a sourced shortlist, not an exhaustive ranking of every Indian manufacturer. No farther-region prospects were needed.
limits: No company has confirmed a requirement, willingness to pay or existing suitable CCTV. Published owner/MD/founder evidence is recorded exactly; unspecified ownership and historical roles remain qualified. Public email publication and MX routing do not guarantee an active inbox or a reply. Some addresses are office locations for manufacturing companies; individual caveats identify where the production address must be reconfirmed. No factory visits, private database purchases, mailbox probes, outreach or drafts were performed.
